as_told.title: Salvatore Pais's 2018 Navy patents from Pax River
as_told.place_text: Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais filed patents for unusual technologies, including a craft that reduces its own inertial mass and a machine that makes high-frequency gravitational waves, while working at Naval Air Station Patuxent River, a Navy test base in Maryland known as Pax River. The researcher UAPGerb says that is where he filed them. Michels dates the patents to 2018 and says they contain basically everything you would need to build a UFO, while Pais himself says he filed five applications, of which three became patents, and that the two rejected ones were the most ordinary.
